PAGE TITLE: OTHER INFORMATION / AGENCY RESPONSE TO OIG REPORT ON NASA’S TOP MANAGEMENT AND PERFORMANCE CHALLENGES

TABLES:
### Instrument Type and Percentage of Total Obligations

| Instrument Type | Percentage of Total Obligations |
| :--- | :--- |
| Firm-Fixed-Price | 31% |
| Cost-Plus-Award-Fee | 28% |
| Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee | 23% |
| Cost-Plus-Incentive-Fee | 6% |
| Grant | 6% |
| Other * | 6% |

* includes Cost-No-Fee, Fixed-Price-Award-Fee, and Time-and-Materials

KEY FACTS:
- In FY 2024, Firm-Fixed-Price instruments accounted for 31% of total obligations.
- Cost-Plus-Award-Fee instruments accounted for 28% of total obligations in FY 2024.
- Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee instruments accounted for 23% of total obligations in FY 2024.
- Cost-Plus-Incentive-Fee instruments accounted for 6% of total obligations in FY 2024.
- Grants accounted for 6% of total obligations in FY 2024.
- Other instruments accounted for 6% of total obligations in FY 2024.
- NASA developed a new Peer Review policy (comparable to the Department of Defense peer review process) for review of actions valued over $1 billion.
